Gut microbiome
The gut microbiome and its interconnected and complex role in overall health is currently of great scientiﬁc and consumer interest.
As of yet, most studies examining ﬁber’s effect on the gut microbiome come from animal models, speciﬁcally rodent-based studies.
One such study demonstrated the role of dietary ﬁber’s role in protecting gnotobiotic rodents’ colonic mucosal barrier from erosion
and therefore overall gastrointestinal health (Desai et al., 2016). While these studies have not been conducted in humans, they point
toward potentially similar beneﬁts as well as trial designs to emulate.
